invariants.rationale: The method must return a List of WriteStatus; returning null would likely violate contract.
The declared return type is List<WriteStatus>; it should always be a List instance.
preserveHoodieMetadata is a boolean parameter, so its only possible values are true or false.
The method relies on accessing clusteringGroup and its getters, so it should be non-null.
strategyParams is passed to other methods; it must not be null or those calls would fail.
